_comment: Korean the audit rewrote at the source, with the form it replaced. Read by scripts/build-content-audit.mjs so the ledger and the audit cannot disagree. Adding a row here does not change the content — edit the entry, then record it.

word_bit.why: 아침 빛 is not the phrase. Korean says 아침 햇살 or 아침 햇빛; 빛 takes no 아침 modifier. Grammatical, and not what anyone says. The modifier was dropped rather than the noun swapped, because the card teaches 빛.

word_pingkeu.why: 핑크색 is one word. Spaced, 핑크 색 is a spacing error in a sentence a beginner is shown as a model — and the Hangul lessons teach spacing. The translations were already "pink", so none of the thirty-one changed.

word_geumbal.why: 금발 already means blond *hair*, so 금발 머리 says hair twice. 금발이 눈에 띄어요 is what a speaker would say. The translations already read "blond hair", so none of the thirty-one changed.
